label: Destructive inundation
inclusion_rule: Water inundation is itself a major destructive event affecting settlements/people/land.
exclusion_rule: Do not require near-total human destruction; do not code routine seasonal flooding.

label: Exterminatory deluge
inclusion_rule: The inundation is intended or described as destroying most/all humanity or the inhabited world.
exclusion_rule: Do not code flood-control or local destructive flooding without broad human-destruction claim.

label: Advance supernatural warning
inclusion_rule: A supernatural/divine/extraordinary agent gives advance information enabling preparation for the flood.
exclusion_rule: Ordinary observation or post-event revelation does not count.

label: Selected survivor group
inclusion_rule: One person/family/small selected group is specifically preserved while a much larger population is destroyed/threatened.
exclusion_rule: A flood-control official or generic survivors without selection do not count.

label: Floating vessel refuge
inclusion_rule: Survival depends on a deliberately used boat/ark/chest/raft or comparable floating container.
exclusion_rule: Travel by ordinary boat unrelated to flood survival does not count.

label: Elevated refuge
inclusion_rule: Survival depends on mountain/tree/tower/other elevated refuge above floodwaters.
exclusion_rule: A vessel merely landing on a mountain afterward does not count.

label: Post-flood ritual or sacrifice
inclusion_rule: Survivor performs sacrifice/offering/ritual soon after survival or recession of waters.
exclusion_rule: Later unrelated cult practice does not count.

label: Post-flood human renewal
inclusion_rule: Narrative explicitly addresses restoration/repopulation/recreation of humanity after flood.
exclusion_rule: Survival alone does not count.

label: Younger divine generation displaces older
inclusion_rule: A younger divine generation or younger deity defeats/displaces an older ruling divine generation.
exclusion_rule: Generic god-vs-monster combat without succession stakes does not count.

label: Father-son succession conflict
inclusion_rule: Divine kingship/supremacy conflict is explicitly structured as father versus son.
exclusion_rule: Other kinship or generational rivalry does not count.

label: Storm deity versus serpent/dragon
inclusion_rule: A storm/thunder-associated deity battles a serpent/dragon/serpentine adversary.
exclusion_rule: Sea deity without serpent/dragon identity is separate.

label: Storm deity versus sea/water deity
inclusion_rule: A storm/thunder-associated deity battles a personified sea/water deity or sovereign aquatic opponent.
exclusion_rule: Serpent/dragon opponent is separate unless text explicitly identifies both.

label: Defeated being becomes cosmos
inclusion_rule: Material from a defeated primordial/divine opponent becomes components of world/cosmos.
exclusion_rule: Death of enemy alone does not count.

label: Divine council deliberation
inclusion_rule: Multiple gods explicitly deliberate, judge, allocate roles, or make a collective decision.
exclusion_rule: A mere list/group of gods does not count.

label: Transfer of divine kingship
inclusion_rule: Narrative explicitly transfers legitimate divine kingship/sovereignty between deities/generations.
exclusion_rule: Victory without kingship transfer does not count.

label: Primordial divine rebellion
inclusion_rule: Cosmic order includes rebellion by subordinate/younger divine beings against established divine authority.
exclusion_rule: Monster attack without a social/political rebellion frame does not count.

label: Human formed from earth/dust
inclusion_rule: Human body is made from generic earth, soil, dust or ground material.
exclusion_rule: Clay/mud may co-occur but is coded separately only when plastic/wet material is explicit.

label: Human formed from clay/mud
inclusion_rule: Human body is made from clay, mud, wet earth or equivalent plastic earth material.
exclusion_rule: Generic dust/earth without wet/plastic quality does not count.

label: Potter-like forming
inclusion_rule: Human creation explicitly uses potter wheel, molding, shaping, kneading or craft-forming technology.
exclusion_rule: Material being clay alone is insufficient.

label: Divine/supernatural body material
inclusion_rule: Human creation incorporates blood, flesh, body or remains of a deity/supernatural being.
exclusion_rule: Cosmos formed from a body is DIV_BODY_TO_COSMOS unless humans specifically arise from it.

label: Breath/wind animates human
inclusion_rule: Breath, wind, spirit-breath or equivalent infusion animates a formed human body.
exclusion_rule: Speech-only creation is not included unless breath/animation is explicit.

label: Humans created for divine service/labour
inclusion_rule: Text explicitly states humans are created to perform labour, cult, maintenance, or service for gods.
exclusion_rule: Later social duty or worship not given as creation purpose does not count.

label: Humans/social order from primordial body sacrifice
inclusion_rule: Human groups or human social categories arise from division/sacrifice of a primordial being.
exclusion_rule: Cosmic body creation without human/social derivation does not count.

label: Explicit first human pair
inclusion_rule: Humanity descends from or begins with an explicitly first male-female/couple pair.
exclusion_rule: A survivor couple after a flood is separate unless narrative makes them first humans.
